description.narrative: The development objective of the program is to progressively restore basic operational performance at a group of core universities in Afghanistan, which will provide an institutional base for an agenda focusing on tertiary education development, capacity building and reform.

condition.narrative: Recipient shall prepare a Project Implementation Manual and furnish it to IDA for review and approval.
Recipient shall, through MOHE, establish and maintain a Steering Committee with functions, staffing and resources satisfactory andacceptable to the Association.
Recipient to carry out project in accordance to Project Implementation Manual
The Recipient shall maintain a Special Disbursement Unit within MOF with functions, staffing, and resources satisfactory andacceptable to the Association
The Recipient shall, through MOHE, cause each beneficiary to establish and maintain a Project Coordination Team to act as thefocalpoint for the implementation of Sub-Projects.

title.narrative: Increased percentage of faculty members with at least Master level degrees

baseline.value: 40% in Balkh, 18% in Herat, 41% in Kabul, 90% in Kabul Polytech, 41% in Nangrahar, 32% Kandahar.

target.value: 50% in Balkh, 30% in Herat, 60% in Kabul, 90% in Kabul Polytech, 50% in Nangarhar, 40% Kandahar

actual.value: 46% in Balkh, 51% in Herat, 77% in Kabul, 92% in Kabul Polytech, 53% in Nangarhar, 36% Kandahar

comment.narrative: 164 Masters qualified staff have returned to universities are teaching. Another 89 are following their Masters courses.

title.narrative: Percent of project faculties using revised and updated curriculum

target.value: 12 universities with revised curriculum in selected Faculties.

actual.value: 63 Faculties out of 95 across the 12 Universities have revised and updated their curricula.

comment.narrative: 52 Faculties out of 95 in all 12 universities have updated their curricula. These are now being studied by the Ministry of HigherEducation.

title.narrative: Percent increase in efficient use of labs, libraries and other facilities in six universities.

target.value: 60% increase in use of labs, teaching and learning facilities in selected faculties of 12 universities

actual.value: 51 percent increase in the use of labs, libraries and other faculty facilities compared to the situation before the project.

comment.narrative: 23 out of 45 targetted labs, libraries and other faculty facilities are currently in use.

title.narrative: Percent increase in efficient use of labs, libraries and other facilities in six universities.

target.value: Labs and teaching and learning facilities in selected Faculties have become operational in 12 universities

comment.narrative: The target has been largely achieved. Only two buildings at Kandahar university and one package of equipment will be completed onemonth after project closing.

actual.value: 18 faculties have received lab facilities, which have been installed and are in use in 8 universities. Computer labs have beeninstalled in 12 universities. Library facilities have been updated in 6 universities.

comment.narrative: Faculties in all twelve universities were targeted for the installation/ rehabilitation of lab equipment and other learningfacilities. Out of these, 18 faculties have received lab facilities, which have been installed and are in use. Another 13 facultiesare awaiting lab equipment, which is being procured. Apart from lab equipment, 6 libraries have been developed and 14 computer labshave been installed in all twelve universities
